samples_reviewed.question_text: Measure the object. Its length is ___ paperclips.
Measure the object. Its length is ___ paperclips.
Compare the numbers: 10 ___ 6. Which sign is correct: >, <, or =?
Compare the numbers: 18 ___ 30. Which sign is correct: >, <, or =?

20 cannot be determined 13. True or False?

How long is the object? Give your answer in paperclips.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency verb is 'Compare lengths and distances', yet none of the eight samples compares two lengths side by side: seeds 42, 43, 46, and 51 are single-object unit-counting tasks like 'Measure the object. Its length is ___ hands.', seeds 44 and 45 are bare numeral comparisons with no object or unit at all, and seed 50 renders the broken sentence '20 cannot be determined 13. True or False?' -- no sample ever asks which of two measured objects is longer.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: 'Distance between two objects', explicitly named in the competency, has zero representation across all eight seeds, and only two non-standard units ever appear, paperclips and hands; the longer/shorter/same-length comparison outcomes the word 'compare' implies are also never generated.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Seed 50's rendered text, '20 cannot be determined 13. True or False?', is a broken, ungrammatical sentence -- the phrase 'cannot be determined', a distractor label from the sign-comparison MCQ, has been substituted where a comparison sign or verb belongs, leaving a Grade 1 reader nothing parseable to evaluate.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Four formatters appear, mcq, true_false, cloze, read_mcq, but the underlying content only ever takes two shapes, a single-object unit count or a bare numeral comparison, so no genuine two-object length-comparison variant exists across the eight seeds.

competency_alignment.rationale: Seeds 44 and 45 vary abstract numeral magnitude, 10 vs 6, then 18 vs 30, with no object, unit, or length referenced at all, building symbolic number comparison rather than the 'compare lengths...using non-standard units' skill this node claims to serve.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Seed 45's raw numerals 18 and 30 break from the 1-10 non-standard-unit range used everywhere else in this node's samples, e.g. seed 51's 5 hands, introducing a two-digit magnitude with no measurement context grounding it.
